description: A plan for one bulk change: the steps our executor runs, in order.

steps.description: The steps, in the order they run.

action.description: What the step does, in a few words.

tool.description: The one tool this step calls, by the name in the tool list.

args_json.description: The tool's arguments as a JSON object encoded as a string. Write "$fill" for a value that depends on an earlier step's result.

depends_on.description: The ids of earlier steps whose results this step uses.

expect.description: What a program can observe in the step's result when it worked.

kind.description: count_equals: the list in `field` has `value` items. non_empty: the list in `field` has at least one item. field_equals: `field` equals `value`. record_written: a pending record was written.

field.description: The result's field the check reads; "" for record_written.

value.description: The value to compare with, as text; "" for non_empty and record_written.
